_generated_by: manual (spiral topology -- geometric free params + generator-derived electrical params)

spacing_um.description: Gap between adjacent turns -- keep >= track_width_um/2, see inductor_spiral_generator.py's build_openems_structure() mesh-resolution comment

l.description: Series inductance of each half-winding -- fitted from a real openEMS Y11 run when available, otherwise a generic placeholder literal. See inductor_spiral_generator.py's fit_electrical_params().

rs.description: Series winding resistance of each half-winding -- same fit/placeholder split as 'l'.

cox.description: Oxide/substrate coupling capacitance at each terminal -- real geometry x GF180MCU Metal5 areacap data, always computed for real (no FDTD needed).

rsub.description: Substrate loss resistance completing each terminal's oxide-coupling path -- PLACEHOLDER quality, not yet derived from any EM run (see gf180mcu_stack.json's substrate.resistivity_ohm_cm note).

csub.description: Substrate capacitance in parallel with rsub at each terminal -- PLACEHOLDER quality, same caveat as rsub.

cs.description: Coupling capacitance from each terminal to the center tap (ct) -- PLACEHOLDER quality; this generator's one-port EM methodology has no distinct 'ct' measurement yet (deferred to a later round).
